en: Black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone street in a European town with late‑19th/early‑20th‑century buildings on both sides. People in period clothing walk or stand along the street, including a uniformed figure in the foreground. In the distance rise two prominent Gothic church towers. German‑language shop signs are visible on the right side of the street. At the very bottom, upside down, appears a handwritten caption that looks like a place name and a number.
